data.name: Spider Wars
data.detailed_description:
Spider Wars is a fast-paced shooter in which you can either work with your fellow spiderkin, or blow them up for glory. Or sport.

Our spiders can traverse any solid surface at any angle. Want to get an edge by walking on the ceiling, raining death from above? Or how about reenacting nursery rhymes with the closest spout? No problem! Just run up to objects and the spiders will attach themselves, allowing you complete freedom in your ascent.

What game about spiders would be complete without the ability to build webs? We don't know. What we do know however, is that you can build them in this game. String webs strand by strand to construct whatever your heart desires. Your ideal spider fortress is now within reach. Perhaps you are not much of a builder; fret not! Use your web to swing around like a certain costumed human who has been stealing all the glory that rightfully belongs to spiderkind. No radiation involved.

Teamwork and our spiders' complimentary abilities plays a large role in our team-based game modes. *
Those same abilities can be used to great effect in our solo modes as well.

To play host to these epic battles, our spider scientists have selected a variety of interesting locales. I wouldn't expect any sanity in the choices however; our scientists are all out of their minds. I hear the majority of them suffer from arachnophobia. We have noticed an alarming amount of traps and hazards in some of these locations...

  • Multiple game modes: Deathmatch is currently available, with more coming soon.
  • Variable camera modes: You can choose to play in either first- or third person.
  • Spider types: Choose from a selection of unique classes for your spider. Each class not only looks distinct, but plays different as well with class specific loadouts and abilities.
  • Webs: All spiders can construct webs on any solid surface. The webs can be used for traversal or defense. You could even construct an artistic web to prove you are a capable home-builder to that spider-crush of yours. Webs do not have to be static however; you can use them to swing around objects - getting the drop on your foes!

Oh, did I mention this game has spiders?

* Our human-spider relations officer tried their best to not use buzzwords after their predecessor was ejected into space for doing so.

data.short_description: Ever wonder what it would be like to be a spider? How about a spider with high-tech armour and weaponry? Well now is your chance in this epic multiplayer high-speed shooter! Do battle with your fellow spiders or just build a web to hang out.

reviews.review:
i really wanted this to be something. im well aware of early access or indev titles being on steam and always want to help out small devs... but honestly this really isnt what it advertises. yes there are spider things to run around in and yes they do spider-like activities plus guns... but there really isnt anything to do. the 2 maps availible are pretty if you run ultra but it doesnt matter if your pc is weak or not its gonna chug every 5 seconds...

of the 2 maps one has nothing in it except some scary looking dragons which are just blocks you can knock over... they litterally flop over... like wth. the other map reminds me of Air Rivals... it looks like late 90s graphics but if you enable ultra the shaders and other features make it pass for something modern... but again there isnt anything to do in it under this spikly thing shows up which then gives you a tour of a puzzle map... a really cool tower puzzle map... and then you get ported to what you think is another puzzle map only to find it its actually a pvp arena which has no purpose in solo play. you cant leave it either.

i know early access... but just to air on caution because steam is rife with scammers... i requested a refund... ill keep an eye on it for when the dev returns to add more to it.

as it is right now the dev says they will be gone for over a year and wont be updating the game...

oh yeah there is a claim that its intended for multiplayer... but multiplayer isnt working and wont be for a looong time according to the latest news letter.
reviews.developer_response:
Hi Cora. Thank you for your honest review. 

I just wanted to clarify a few points. There are actually quite a few levels in Single player. The First level is completed by exploring the Level. Once you have completed the objective a portal to the next level will open. There are a few more puzzle elements to the game as well as some combat orientated.

The Multiplayer does actually work. We do not have very many players playing so there is a low chance of running into another player. We have been trying to work on this but it is tough when Players keep saying multiplayer does not work. 

Thank you for taking the time to try out our Game.
